messages:
olivia: Heads-up: we enabled the faststart-pack optimization on the 4x-medium GPU pool at 08:10. Rolling watch is on. :satellite:
rakesh: Sweet. Any early telemetry yet?
olivia: Short-run numbers: p50 for short prompts dropped from ~410ms -> ~120ms, p95 880ms -> 340ms, p99 1.45s -> 620ms. Very consistent across hosts.
meera: That's a big tail improvement. Did you change batching behavior too or just warmup packing?
olivia: Just warmup packing + a tiny scheduler tweak to align microbatches. Steady-state throughput unchanged. The scheduler tweak actually reduced microbatch fragmentation by ~6%.
tom: Can you paste the quick repro command so we can run locally?
olivia: Sure: ```bash
./run_microbench --model rwd-4-wide --pool 4x-medium --seq 64 --mode faststart --iters 8000 --metrics p50,p95,p99
```
Sample pooled output: ```
baseline: p50 410ms p95 880ms p99 1450ms
faststart-pack: p50 120ms p95 340ms p99 620ms
```
(measured across 5 hosts, median-of-medians)
rakesh: Any memory or cache side-effects? We don't want eviction storms.
olivia: Observed a modest increase in ephemeral KV churn (~10%) and ~5% higher working set per worker. No eviction escalations and no OOMs in canary.
perf-bot: [perf-check] Canary report: 5/5 buckets green; p99 improved in all buckets; no regression on p50/p95.
meera: Nice. What's the rollout plan / gating?
olivia: Rollout notes: 1) Faststart enabled behind feature-flag on Dedicated 4x-medium only 2) Monitor perf-check and kv_eviction_rate 3) Abort if p99 regresses or OOMs observed 4) Flip hosted rollout after 72h stable.
tom: Can we add a public-facing blurb for customers? SolutionsEng will want to call out lower cold-starts.
olivia: Yup. I'll draft a short entry for release-notes and a one-pager for SEs. Also adding a telemetry metric faststart_hit_rate and a diagnostic tag to indicate which requests benefited.
rakesh: Suggest we include a cost sim run. Even small per-token wins can compound.
olivia: Agreed. Kicking off a 72h cost-sim now; will share numbers Monday.
infra-bot: [deploy] feature-flag faststart-pack enabled on pool 4x-medium by olivia at 2026-03-23T08:10Z
meera: Congrats team :tada:
olivia: Huge kudos to runtime + scheduler + infra for moving fast. Will post followup with graphs and the sim results.
